request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: What amount in euro is paid to the verifier for the periodic verification of the 35,000 kg gantry crane at position 23?

response.text: {"kind": "unknown", "value": null, "text": "The files do not give a euro amount. Position 23 is the 35,000 kg 'gru a cavalletto' (gantry crane) in IGEA's Allegato A, Tabella A5 (igea-equipment.md, p. 5-6). IGEA's schedule says the fee is calculated from the tariff in the Decreto Dirigenziale of 23/11/2012, with ISTAT indices and the contractor's discount, but that tariff itself is not in the files. INAIL's guide (inail-guide.md, pp. 37-38) likewise refers to that tariff without stating an amount.", "sources": [{"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 3 (2. Specifiche tecniche generali, 2.7) and p. 4 (2.6)", "quote": "2.6 Per le prestazioni di cui al punto 2.5, come base d'asta di riferimento verrà utilizzato il tariffario, con gli indici ISTAT aggiornati, emanato dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali ... attraverso il Decreto Dirigenziale del 23/11/2012 ... 2.7 Per ciascun apparecchio di sollevamento in elenco ... verrà corrisposto l'importo calcolato sulla base di quanto disposto al punto 2.6 e col ribasso proposto dall' Aggiudicatario"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 6, Tabella A5 (and p. 9, Tabella B3)", "quote": "23 GRU A CAVALLETTO 35000 NU 16/95 1989 459 GCB 35 X 12/21 Classe: matr.459"}, {"file": "inail-guide.md", "place": "Section 5.1, Prima verifica periodica di apparecchi di sollevamento (p. 37-38)", "quote": "l'importo dovuto all'Inail sarà pari al 100% di quanto previsto dal tariffario di cui al decreto dirigenziale 23 novembre 2012 ... ovvero pari al 15% (se la prima verifica periodica viene eseguita dal soggetto abilitato indicato dal datore di lavoro nella richiesta e delegato dall'Inail)."}]}
